meta.name: agent-designer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to design a multi-agent system, pick an orchestration pattern (supervisor/swarm/pipeline), generate tool schemas for agents, or evaluate agent execution logs for cost, latency, and failure bottlenecks. Examples: 'design an agent architecture for research automation', 'generate Anthropic tool schemas from these tool descriptions', 'analyze these agent run logs for bottlenecks'. NOT for Claude Code workflow files (use workflow-builder) or single-agent prompt design (use agent-workflow-designer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体系统架构并分析运行日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或优化多智能体协作系统
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent system architectures and analyze execution logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize multi-agent collaboration systems

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计多智能体系统、选择协作模式、生成工具接口定义，并分析运行日志找出成本、延迟和失败瓶颈。
howto.when: 当你要求设计多智能体系统、选择编排模式、生成工具接口定义，或分析智能体运行日志时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个研究自动化的多智能体架构。
根据这些工具描述生成 Anthropic 格式的工具接口。
say.note: Claude 会生成并验证工具接口定义。

say.text: 分析这些智能体运行日志，找出瓶颈。
say.note: Claude 会输出成功率、延迟分布、成本和优化建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design multi-agent systems, choose orchestration patterns, generate tool schemas, and analyze execution logs for cost, latency, and failure bottlenecks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a multi-agent system, pick an orchestration pattern, generate tool schemas, or evaluate agent execution logs.

say_en.text: Design a multi-agent architecture for research automation.
say_en.note: Claude outputs architecture design, Mermaid diagram, and roadmap.

say_en.text: Generate Anthropic tool schemas from these tool descriptions.
say_en.note: Claude generates and validates tool schemas.

say_en.text: Analyze these agent run logs for bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Claude outputs success rate, latency, cost, and recommendations.
